temporal_density.static_hold_policy: no static holds in working render; every output frame receives camera, atmosphere, lighting, particle and/or audio-reactive state change
temporal_density.keyframe_density_target: 27 editorial scenes over 163.12 seconds with continuous per-frame motion and additional generated continuation/story frames
temporal_density.video_insert_policy: short animation-like inserts and impact cuts at major musical and narrative transitions
temporal_density.intermediate_frame_policy: continuous 30 fps authored transforms plus atmosphere and transient accents; interpolation is not used to disguise static content
